subject: general
question: What has been the trend in India’s per capita income since the 1991 reforms?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Gradual increase**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India's **economic reforms in 1991**, also known as the **Liberalisation, Privatisation, and Globalisation (LPG)** reforms, marked a significant shift in its economic policies. These reforms opened up the economy to **foreign investments**, introduced market-driven mechanisms, and reduced government control in various sectors.
 
• Since 1991, India's **per capita income** has shown a **gradual increase**. This growth can be attributed to factors such as a rise in **economic activity**, growth in the **services sector**, and improved industrial performance.
 
• India's **Gross Domestic Product (GDP)** has witnessed substantial growth during this period, leading to an increase in the average income of individuals.
 
• Improved **global trade relations** and an influx of **foreign direct investment (FDI)** have contributed to the economic prosperity of the country.
 
• The **service sector**, including industries such as **IT and telecommunications**, played a pivotal role in driving economic growth and enhancing per capita income.
 
• The government introduced various policies to promote **entrepreneurship, start-ups**, and domestic industries, further boosting income levels.
 
• Social indicators such as better access to **education, healthcare**, and **technology** also contributed to the gradual improvement in per capita income.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Constant decline**__

 __
 
• India's economic trajectory has not shown a **constant decline** since 1991. The reforms brought about significant improvements in GDP growth, investment, and overall economic performance.
 
 
 
• **Fluctuating without a pattern**__
 
 
• While there have been periods of **economic fluctuations** due to global and domestic factors, the overall trend has been positive and **gradual growth**, rather than random fluctuations.
